method: BetMGM and Oddschecker are devigged and averaged into a coherent sportsbook consensus. For 1X2, Opta contributes 25% of the external layer and the sportsbook consensus contributes 75%; the internal model then receives 25% of the combined center. This gives nominal center weights of 56.25% sportsbook, 18.75% Opta and 25% internal. For O/U 2.5, no direct Opta probability exists, so the center is 75% sportsbook and 25% internal. Polymarket is excluded from fair probability and used only as execution cost.

decision_parameters.p_trade_rule: For 1X2, p_external = 0.75 * sportsbook_consensus + 0.25 * Opta; for O/U 2.5, p_external = sportsbook_consensus. Then p_center = 0.75 * p_external + 0.25 * p_internal. uncertainty = max(0.5pp, 0.5 * sportsbook source dispersion + 0.1 * absolute internal/external disagreement + 0.25pp data-quality penalty). Directional p_trade is the lower bound p_center - uncertainty; complement outcomes are constructed from the coherent base probability before applying the same uncertainty. The uncalibrated scenario p10 remains diagnostic only.
